proves.claim: With gate.pulledProfilePaths on, the check profile file the settled pulled gate names exists beside its sanitized log.

cli.journeys-gate-pulled-profile.check-p.why: Without it, a pulled gate could name a profile its runner never kept and nothing would notice.

proves.claim: With gate.pulledProfilePaths on, the proof profile file the settled pulled gate names exists beside its sanitized log.

cli.journeys-gate-pulled-profile.proof-p.why: Without it, a pulled gate could name a proof profile its runner never kept and nothing would notice.
